The day's log

    A fight on this adventure's maps starts from this state and writes it back when it ends; rolling Initiative interrupts a rest.

    Downtime: crafting, brewing, scribing

    Between adventures each character can make one thing at a time: craft an item, brew a Potion of Healing, scribe a Spell Scroll or craft a magic item (SRD 5.2.1). Gold comes from the Market purse; the finished item goes into the bag.

    Start a project
    each day: 8 hours of work on every project, then a Long Rest

    Mental stress

    SRD 5.2.1 Fear and Mental Stress: a save at your DC; Psychic damage on a failure (half on a success if you say so); a lasting effect on a failure.
